products.label: Nearby galaxy distribution
products.process: Join CF4 and HyperLEDA identities; prepare a bounded position sample and Gaussian galaxy-count concentrations.
limitations: Authored rendering parameters. Sampled points retain measured catalogue positions; covariance clouds represent smoothed galaxy counts, not gas or measured matter density.
Positive HI velocity / H0 fallback is uncorrected for peculiar velocities. Survey gaps and exclusions do not prove cosmic voids.
